title: Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor and Parkinson’s Disease

criteria.text: FDA-approved DBS device (or Category B IDE trial protocol)
criteria.span: Medicare will only consider DBS devices to be reasonable and necessary if they are Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved devices for DBS

criteria.text: VIM: ET (postural/kinetic hand tremor without other neurologic signs) or tremor-dominant idiopathic PD
criteria.span: Diagnosis of ET based on postural or kinetic tremors of hand(s) without other neurologic signs, or diagnosis of idiopathic PD (presence of at least 2 cardinal PD features (tremor, rigidity or bradykinesia)) which is of a tremor-dominant form

criteria.text: VIM: disabling tremor at least level 3 or 4 on Fahn-Tolosa-Marin despite optimal medical therapy
criteria.span: Marked disabling tremor of at least level 3 or 4 on the Fahn-Tolosa-Marin Clinical Tremor Rating Scale (or equivalent scale) in the extremity intended for treatment, causing significant limitation in daily activities despite optimal medical therapy

criteria.text: Willing and able to cooperate during awake surgery and post-op adjustments
criteria.span: Willingness and ability to cooperate during conscious operative procedure, as well as during post-surgical evaluations, adjustments of medications and stimulator settings

criteria.text: STN/GPi: advanced idiopathic PD by Hoehn and Yahr or UPDRS III
criteria.span: Advanced idiopathic PD as determined by the use of Hoehn and Yahr stage or Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS) part III motor subscale

criteria.text: STN/GPi: L-dopa responsive with clearly defined on periods
criteria.span: L-dopa responsive with clearly defined "on" periods

criteria.text: STN/GPi: persistent disabling symptoms or drug side effects despite optimal medical therapy
criteria.span: Persistent disabling Parkinson's symptoms or drug side effects (e.g., dyskinesias, motor fluctuations, or disabling "off" periods) despite optimal medical therapy

criteria.text: Exclusion: non-idiopathic PD or Parkinson-plus syndromes
criteria.span: Non-idiopathic Parkinson's disease or "Parkinson's Plus" syndromes

criteria.text: Exclusion: cognitive impairment, dementia or depression that would worsen or interfere
criteria.span: Cognitive impairment, dementia or depression, which would be worsened by or would interfere with the patient's ability to benefit from DBS

criteria.text: Exclusion: current psychosis, alcohol or drug abuse
criteria.span: Current psychosis, alcohol abuse or other drug abuse

criteria.text: Exclusion: previous movement disorder surgery in the affected basal ganglion
criteria.span: Previous movement disorder surgery within the affected basal ganglion

criteria.text: Movement disorders specialist involved in patient selection and post-procedure care
criteria.span: Physicians specializing in movement disorders must be involved in both patient selection and post-procedure care

criteria.text: Exclusion: structural lesion (basal ganglionic stroke, tumor, vascular malformation) as etiology of the movement disorder
criteria.span: Structural lesions such as basal ganglionic stroke, tumor or vascular malformation as etiology of the movement disorder

criteria.text: STN/GPi: diagnosis of PD with at least 2 cardinal features
criteria.span: Diagnosis of PD based on the presence of at least 2 cardinal PD features (tremor, rigidity or bradykinesia)

criteria.text: Exclusion: significant co-morbidities contraindicating DBS surgery or stimulation
criteria.span: Significant medical, surgical, neurologic or orthopedic co-morbidities contraindicating DBS surgery or stimulation

notes: VIM criteria (C2-C4) and STN/GPi criteria (C4-C7, C14) differ: VIM does not require L-dopa response or advanced PD staging; STN/GPi is covered only for PD. Pacemakers/other implants and MRI/diathermy appear only as cautions, not exclusions. Psychosis and substance exclusions apply only when current; cognitive/depression exclusion applies only when it would be worsened by or interfere with benefit from DBS.
